log.headline: Sorted 75 quiet Macs in Jamf
log.detail: I checked each Mac that had gone quiet in our device inventory and decided its fate: 16 old Intel laptops were retired, 2 were repaired, 13 were turned into spares, and 14 were renamed, with the rest left in place for specific reasons.
